name: View API Response
description: Admin tool to call configured external HTTP APIs and view their responses in array format.
project_description:
It provides an user interface to view the response of each API in array format.

 CONFIGURATION 

 
 Go to /admin/structure/view-api-response and click "Add API Response Type" button. 
 
 
 Click "Add API" button to add each API details. 
 
 
 Update the necessary details and click the save button. 
 
 
 To view the API response for the each API, Click the Edit link on the "View API Response Type" page

 and click the "View [ID] API Response" button on top of the edit page.
